SMTO-EXE-0161 — SMTO lost contact with the computer it was controlling

GUID: 94f64a79-abdc-5f12-b951-3cc1ae5e3830
Slug: ui-gateway-lost
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • SMTO couldn't get a reliable answer from the Gateway while working in an app on that computer. If you had asked SMTO to stop, the action may still be running there.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Make sure the Gateway's computer is switched on, awake and connected to the network. SMTO controls that computer's apps through the Gateway, so it needs a working connection.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check connection for that Gateway. This confirms SMTO can reach the Gateway again.
  3. Look at the app on that computer and check whether the last click or typing already happened before asking SMTO to continue. A lost connection doesn't tell SMTO whether the action happened, so repeating it blindly could do it twice.

What success looks like

  • The Gateway shows as connected, and SMTO can see the app's current screen again.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the Gateway's computer. Don't repeat clicks or typing just because the connection dropped or a stop wasn't confirmed.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Server could not get a reliable Desktop UI response from the selected Gateway (connection failure, rejected request, or a failed /ui/cancel control call).

What this means

  • The desktop connection failed while requesting a UI operation or its control response. The operation phase and receipt determine whether a click or typing action could have taken effect. A failed read does not establish anything about earlier actions; an unconfirmed cancellation does not establish that an action stopped.

Why this can happen

  • The selected Gateway did not provide a usable UI or cancellation response. Its current connection state and operation receipt narrow the cause and outcome.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the selected Gateway’s connection and desktop status. Use ui.status, then a fresh ui.snapshot where available, to compare the current screen with the saved operation receipt.

How to fix it

  • Restore connectivity to the selected Gateway (Check connection in the Gateway table, Gateway log), then run ui.status and a fresh scoped ui.snapshot. If the failure was on cancellation, the native action may still be running: wait for ui_busy to clear and reconcile any unconfirmed click or typing before repeating it.
  • Restore contact with the selected Gateway and inspect its desktop status and a fresh screen snapshot. Reconcile any unconfirmed click or typing action before repeating it.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect ui.status and a fresh scoped ui.snapshot on the selected Gateway. Correct the target or prerequisites before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • The selected Gateway returns current desktop status and a fresh snapshot, and any earlier action’s outcome is reconciled.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat clicks or typing based only on a lost connection or cancellation response.

Technical notes

  • The UI adapter uses gateway_lost for read/prestart failures, operation_outcome_unknown for possible mutations; cancellation failures may leave an action running.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
